primary_metric: delivered training trajectories per steady-state second
memory_gate: max(NVML sampled peak, PyTorch peak reserved + 512 MiB) <= total VRAM - max(3072 MiB, 15% total VRAM)
adaptive: Compare best at 1/4 CPU threads and minibatches 1/2/4; at most 9 screened configs; verify top two with two seeds; 65 minute total VM job budget.
caveats: Replay scale 16 is a memory-conscious tuning choice versus repository default 64. Batch and minibatch changes affect learning dynamics. Optimize measured throughput, not strength or convergence. No global optimum claim.
budget_adjustment: Before verification, initial L4 measurements showed 8.4 s/iteration at collect=256. Reduce planned verification from 32+24 to 16+16 (replay remains fully warmed) and screening cap from14 to9 to reserve time for two-seed confirmation.
